idea-plugin.name: Field Assignment Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Generates field assignments for C++ structs and classes from code completion.

Alpha version. Expect occasional bugs and unsupported language constructs while the plugin is being actively developed. Feedback and bug reports are welcome.

Example


DXGI_ADAPTER_DESC desc;
desc.

↓


desc.Description = ;
desc.VendorId = ;
desc.DeviceId = ;
desc.SubSysId = ;
...

Features

  • Supports . and ->
  • Respects CLion formatting settings
  • Editable hotspots for quick value entry
